text:
Maya: Heads up — putting together an 'eval passport' for v2p4-int4 bringup. Need explicit gates for canary->promote. Draft below.

Maya: TL;DR: require metric pass on concordance & MRR, no regression >1.5% on worst slice, latency P99 within 1.4x baseline, and automated rollback thresholds.

Sam: Love it. Can we add a 'grace window' to avoid noisy alerts during small sample sizes? :thinking: 

Maya: yes — grace=30m or min_samples=200 per slice. noted.

Jin: propose tie-breaker: if concordance delta between candidates within 0.3%, prefer lower-cost variant unless delta >0.5%.

Olivia: for automatic fallback: set an absolute perf delta threshold and a rolling Z-score for drift. Example rule below:

`````
# autopromote config
min_samples: 1000
grace_window_mins: 30
rollout_steps: [0.01, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5]
concordance_delta_threshold_pct: 1.5
latency_p99_mult: 1.4
fallback_zscore: 3.0
`````

Noah: alerting hooks? If fallback triggers, we should auto-route 100% to previous stable for 10m and page on-call if persisted >20m.

Maya: deploy-bot will handle the immediate route change. eval-bot will post a detailed regression report.

deploy-bot: Deploy action queued: promote v2p4-int4 -> step 0.01. Will monitor metrics every 5m. :rocket: 

eval-bot: Smokecheck scheduled. Will post slice-level table and small example diffset when available.

Sam: One more ask — integrate prompt-level fingerprinting for long-context tests (seqlen>2048) to catch prefix mismatches.

Maya: added. Also adding an explicit 'manual hold' flag for legal/regression review.

Olivia: uploaded small checklist doc to Google: https://go/redwood/rollout-passport

Maya: ok let's run this on staging today and run a 2h shadow against production traffic tomorrow morning. If any fuzziness, hold. :thumbsup:

Noah: I'll be on-call during the run.

Maya: thanks team — will open the formal promotion runbook and link here.
